<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#666CA699"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" rx="20" fill="#666CA6CC"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" rx="20" fill="#333FB699" opacity="0.28"/>

  <!-- photographic travel background fallback -->
  <rect x="0" y="92" width="390" height="686" fill="#666CA6CC"/>
  <circle cx="298" cy="194" r="48" fill="#FCFCFC" opacity="0.62"/>
  <polygon points="0,540 104,382 174,470 238,330 390,530 390,778 0,778" fill="#333FB699" opacity="0.72"/>
  <polygon points="0,620 78,500 141,556 216,448 390,625 390,778 0,778" fill="#666CA699" opacity="0.9"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="778" x2="390" y2="778" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="28" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="327" y1="24" x2="327" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="332" y1="24" x2="332" y2="15" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="337" y1="24" x2="337" y2="12" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="350" cy="19" r="3" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <path d="M346 19 Q350 14 354 19" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="363" y="14" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="365" y="16" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="384" y="18" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- title -->
  <text x="195" y="166" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Katibeh" font-size="60" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Travelers</text>
  <text x="195" y="194" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Travel community app</text>

  <!-- login panel -->
  <rect x="35" y="245" width="320" height="55" rx="10" fill="#666CA6CC" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <text x="55" y="263" font-family="Inter" font-size="8" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">EMAIL ADDRESS</text>
  <line x1="55" y1="272" x2="335" y2="272" stroke="#666CA699" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="285" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <polyline points="60,285 65,289 70,285" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <text x="82" y="290" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">hello@travelers.app</text>

  <rect x="35" y="317" width="320" height="55" rx="10" fill="#666CA6CC" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
  <text x="55" y="335" font-family="Inter" font-size="8" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">PASSWORD</text>
  <line x1="55" y1="344" x2="335" y2="344" stroke="#666CA699" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="61" y="354" width="9" height="8" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <polyline points="63,354 63,351 68,351 68,354" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <text x="82" y="362" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="3" fill="#FFFFFF">••••••••</text>

  <text x="35" y="396" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Keep your journeys close.</text>
  <text x="355" y="396" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">Forgot password?</text>

  <!-- primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="35" y="438" width="320" height="55" rx="10" fill="#333FB699" filter="url(#shadow)"/>
    <text x="195" y="472" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Log in</text>
  </g>

  <!-- supporting trust content -->
  <rect x="35" y="523" width="320" height="86" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.82"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="553" r="16" fill="#666CA6CC"/>
  <circle cx="67" cy="548" r="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <ellipse cx="67" cy="561" rx="10" ry="6" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="94" y="551" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">Your next adventure starts here</text>
  <text x="94" y="571" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">Connect with travelers, share stories,</text>
  <text x="94" y="587" font-family="Montserrat" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#000000">and discover places worth remembering.</text>

  <text x="195" y="658" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">New to Travelers?</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="107" y="674" width="176" height="40" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
    <text x="195" y="699" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#333FB699">Create an account</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom action area -->
  <rect x="0" y="778" width="390" height="66" rx="0" fill="#666CA6CC"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="779" x2="370" y2="779" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.35"/>

  <!-- navigation icons -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6">
    <polygon points="38,800 48,792 58,800 58,810 38,810" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
    <polyline points="35,800 48,789 61,800"/>
    <rect x="92" y="793" width="17" height="17" rx="2"/>
    <line x1="97" y1="793" x2="97" y2="810"/>
    <line x1="104" y1="793" x2="104" y2="810"/>
    <circle cx="170" cy="799" r="9"/>
    <line x1="164" y1="799" x2="176" y2="799"/>
    <line x1="170" y1="793" x2="170" y2="805"/>
    <rect x="232" y="792" width="18" height="15" rx="4"/>
    <polygon points="235,807 235,812 241,807" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="318" cy="800" r="8"/>
    <line x1="318" y1="800" x2="318" y2="794"/>
    <line x1="318" y1="800" x2="323" y2="803"/>
  </g>
  <text x="48" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="9" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Home</text>
  <text x="100" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="9" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Explore</text>
  <text x="170" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="9" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Trips</text>
  <text x="241" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="9" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Community</text>
  <text x="318" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="9" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Alerts</text>
</svg>
